dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Need to buy a weapon? Or have one custom-built? Repairs are free, just let me know if you come across any prize ore.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you selling?

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Quality weapons made from the finest ore using time-honored techniques. Take your pick.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like something made.

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: (No equipment to collect)

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Have you brought the right materials? Let's see the goods.

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: (Equipment to collect)

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Oh, your order from last time is ready. Are you here to collect it, or to place a new order?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Hanfeng's Ironmongers...

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: My dad left me this place when he retired. He lives in Qingce Village now.

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: When he left me the shop, he also left me with a word of advice — a solid business is founded on solid relationships.

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Whenever I get laborers and miners coming in here for repairs, I never charge them for it. In return, I only ask that they keep me informed when they find any rare ore.

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: It's every ironmonger's dream to fashion a legendary weapon, the sharpest blade of them all... Liyue is the land of the Lord of Geo, so I figure this is where I'll have the best chance of finding the prize ore I'd need...

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: If I can get the edge over the competition right from the source, from the raw materials, I can push them out and really strengthen the Hanfeng name... Hehehe, so let me know if you find anything!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Bye. Come back if you ever need anything.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like something made.

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Have you brought the right materials? Let's see the goods.

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>I'd like something made.</color>

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Oh, your order from last time is ready. Are you here to collect it, or to place a new order?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>What do you have to sell?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Quality weapons made from the finest ore using time-honored techniques. Take your pick.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Liyue's mining products...

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Ores... You've been to the many ore veins nearby, haven't you?

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: I don't have anything new for you right now. Perhaps you should try your luck later.
